scope: Documentation registry/build remediation and exact GitHub Actions platform-matrix verification only; does not close WP14 or award points.

provenance.contract_freeze_commit_rule: The Git commit containing this contract is the contract-freeze SHA and is recorded in the execution record.

allowed: Documentation front matter and lifecycle metadata required by the registered-document schema.
Documentation publisher review-metadata denominator and lifecycle-status normalization.
Targeted documentation tests and evidence records for G06/G08.
prohibited: Numerical thresholds, qualification criteria, package version, release claims, or ledger changes.
Fabricating reviewer, approver, Owner, or approval data.
Rewriting historical numerical evidence or reclassifying prior gate failures.

g06_documentation.acceptance: All six frozen documentation commands complete with exit code 0 on the exact candidate source; registered Markdown parses, includes all four required schema fields, and its normalized lifecycle status matches the registry.
g06_documentation.review_metadata_interpretation: Non-empty reviewer/approver values measure metadata completeness only. They do not establish an Owner decision. Draft, candidate, preparation, pending-review, and superseded records are not counted as already reviewed.
g06_documentation.failure_behavior: FAIL_CLOSED; preserve logs and artifacts; do not weaken criteria.

g08_platform_matrix.acceptance: Every required standard-baseline leg must complete on the exact candidate commit and report success. Local Windows/Python 3.13 results do not imply any other leg passed.
g08_platform_matrix.failure_behavior: NOT_RUN remains NOT_RUN; any failed or missing leg blocks G08 PASS.
